message: Thanks for talking with us. Our opening proposal is $6.00 per unit for orders of 500 to 5000 units. 30% is paid at shipment and 70% on receipt. We ship within 14 days, with a 2-day grace period. After that the price drops 5% per day late, capped at 30%. The cancel window is 30 days and deemed acceptance is 7 days. We're happy to talk through any of it.
